visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing black Kuromi-patterned pajamas stands in a brightly lit modern bedroom. They bend over to lift a hydraulic storage bed frame, revealing a compartment filled with plush toys and boxed items. The background features off-white curtains and a minimalist headboard. (2) The person sits on the bed holding two large cardboard boxes with the 'Miss Pearl' logo. They smile and gesture towards the boxes, then kneel on the bed which has two different colored mattress pads (yellow and grey). (3) Close-up shots of the pillows are shown. The person lies down, testing different pillow heights and positions, wearing glasses and an expressive facial expression. Graphic overlays appear showing the internal structure of the foam. (4) A different female character in a dark red silk nightgown appears, interacting with the pillows in a storage-like area with many boxes. She presses down on the pillow to demonstrate its elasticity. (5) Cut to a younger male sleeping soundly on the pillow, followed by an elderly woman also resting on it. Detailed graphics explain the 'LV Memory Foam' and 'Pearl White Gold' models, highlighting breathability and support. (6) The main character returns to the bed, lying horizontally across two pillows, looking relaxed. The video ends with them tucked under the covers, seemingly asleep as text overlays appear.
